info.name: WorkMan API
info.description:
API test collection for the WorkMan service platform (Laravel backend).

Covers the full journey against the seeded demo environment:
1. Public discovery (health, categories, technician search, profiles, reviews)
2. Authentication (client / technician / admin, token handling, 401 guard)
3. Client booking request + favorites
4. Technician acceptance with transport fee
5. Transport payment via mobile money, escrow hold/release, live location, work lifecycle, completion + review
6. Admin dashboard, verification approvals, user management

Environment variable: `baseUrl` → `http://localhost:8000/api` (or any deployed instance).

item.name: Log In — Client
item.description: Signs in Awa Diallo (client) and stores her bearer token for the rest of the run.

item.name: Log In — Technician
item.description: Signs in Michael Kone (plumbing technician, verified).

item.name: Unauthenticated Access Blocked
item.description: No Authorization header — the API must reject with 401.

item.name: Create Booking Request
item.description: Books Michael Kone (Leak repair) for the next weekday at 10:00 UTC — inside his working hours.

body.raw:
{
  "technician_profile_id": 1,
  "service_id": 1,
  "scheduled_at": "{{scheduledAt}}",
  "service_city": "Douala",
  "service_address": "Rue Joffre, Akwa",
  "duration_minutes": 60,
  "notes": "Automated API test — please ignore."
}

script.exec:
pm.test("Status code is 201", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test("Favorite saved", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().favorite).to.be.true; });

item.name: Accept Booking
item.description: Michael accepts Awa's booking request and sets a 1,500 FCFA transport fee.

item.name: Create Transport Payment
item.description: Awa pays the 1,500 FCFA transport fee via MTN MoMo (simulated in local dev).

item.name: Confirm Transport Payment
item.description: Mobile-money confirmation (simulated) — the fee is now held in escrow.

item.name: Release Transport Fee
item.description: Awa releases the escrowed transport fee so Michael can start the job.

item.name: Share Live Location
item.description: Michael shares his live GPS position from Akwa so the client can track him.
